_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.description: Every persona names the human or legal entity it acts for at creation time; a persona with no declared basis cannot be created, and the basis is immutable thereafter
requirements.title: Persona is a durable object with a declared legal basis

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-001] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: A persona binds into agent-manager's signed claims through persona_id in Claims.Meta and the persona.act-as scope, so the chain runs legal person to persona to account subject to run token to child token without a second identity system
requirements.title: The delegation chain is one chain, not two

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Identity verification runs through agent-manager's live endpoint; an unverifiable or unreachable caller cannot act as any persona, and the refusal is recorded rather than downgraded to a weaker evidence grade
requirements.title: Acting as a persona fails closed

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-003] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Each persona declares which humans may act as it and which may only propose actions for approval; the ACL is evaluated server-side and is the one permission concept the existing scope machinery does not already provide
requirements.title: Persona ACL governs who may act

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-004] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: A persona owns an address it can both send from and read, so verification mail is retrievable without an agent ever touching the operator's personal inbox
requirements.title: A controlled email address per persona

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-005] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Exactly one typed contract admits a one-time code into the system; email, an SMS provider, and device-control reading a leased phone are all ordinary adapters satisfying it, with no privileged path
requirements.title: One OTP retrieval seam, many adapters

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-006] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: A step no machine may take produces a checkpoint naming exactly what a human must do, with every other field already filled in, and the flow resumes at that checkpoint once the human is done
requirements.title: Handoff is a typed, resumable state and never an error

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-007] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Documents live in document-manager under its sensitivity class and custody journal; this scenario stores only which persona owns which document and never holds the bytes
requirements.title: Identity documents are bound, never stored

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-008] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: A document is released only into a pre-declared handoff, evaluated server-side; there is no agent-readable read path for a passport or an incorporation record under any scope
requirements.title: Document release requires a named handoff

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-009] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Each kind carries its own identifier set and neither may borrow the other's documents, addresses, or legal basis
requirements.title: Personal and business personas are distinct kinds

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-010] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Acting as, releasing, retrieving a code, opening and completing a handoff are all journaled with the verified run and the authorising human; no verb rewrites or deletes a journal row
requirements.title: Every persona action is attributable and append-only

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-011] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: A consumer such as treasury or a checkout driver resolves a persona through exactly one call that returns what it is entitled to see and nothing more, so entitlement is decided here rather than at each call site
requirements.title: One typed resolution contract for consumers

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-012] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: No default persona and no silent fallback; an outbound action names the persona it acts as or it is refused, because a wrong guess about identity is unrecoverable
requirements.title: A persona is selected, never inferred

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PSN-P0-013] tag) once the behavior exists.
